unitForm.grades_required: Choose the cosmetic and functional grades to finish testing.
unitForm.not_sellable_hint: With this grade the unit will be marked “Not sellable”.

place.title: Smart placement
place.hint: The suggested slot is where similar units already are (same model, brand or type); if there are none, an empty slot in the preferred area. You can change any suggestion.

reason.rule_empty: Empty slot on the level made for this unit

place.rule_warning: Placed even though they do not match the level rule: {{list}}

addToOrder.title: Reserve {{count}} unit(s) in an order
addToOrder.no_lines_hint: Orders with no lines cannot take units: add a line first, or create a new order from here.

testing.title: Testing
testing.subtitle: Register each unit, fill in its data and assign its grades. When finished it becomes available for sale.
testing.pick_lot: Choose the lot you are testing
testing.no_lots: No lots are ready for testing. The lot must have its count finished.
testing.line_hint: The line data (brand, model…) is copied to the unit.
testing.serial_hint: Scan or type the serial and press Enter
testing.qty_hint: For units without serial: creates several at once.
testing.skip_test: This lot does not require individual testing: register directly as available
testing.skip_test_hint: Created without a serial or grades, immediately available for sale.
testing.select_unit_hint: Tap a unit in the list to edit it (if it is in testing, to finish it), or create one with “New unit”, “Repeat last” or “Clone”.
testing.bulk_hint: The same grades are applied to all. It only works if they already have all required data.
testing.no_line_hint: Doesn't match any expected line of the lot, but it belongs to the lot
testing.unlinked_note: {{n}} unit(s) don't match the lot's expected lines (e.g. another brand or model). They are part of the lot too and are listed here.
testing.clone_hint: Opens the form with the same data, without the serial number
testing.repeat_title: Repeat last ({{code}}) — no serial or grades
testing.no_previous: You haven't registered any unit yet
testing.delete_msg: The unit is removed completely. This is only possible while testing has not been finished.
testing.not_placed: {{code}} has no available slot under the placement rules
testing.sold_locked: This unit has already been sold and cannot be edited.

units.title: Inventory
units.subtitle: All units, with their grades, status and location
units.search: Search by code or serial number…
units.empty_hint: Units appear here as they are registered during testing.
units.label: Label
units.codes_copied: {{count}} code(s) copied: paste them where you need them
units.copy_failed: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy these codes:
units.delete_msg: It is removed from the inventory completely. Only possible while it has not been sold.
units.delete_reserved: It is reserved in order {{order}}: it will be removed from it.
units.empty_available_hint: All units are reserved, sold, in testing or not sellable. Pick other statuses in the panel on the left to see them.
units.grp_config_hint: Choose how to group (up to 6 levels, e.g. Type → Brand → Processor → RAM) and change the order by dragging or with the arrows. Remembered on this device.
units.grp_pick_hint: Use the settings button above to choose what to group by.
units.grp_manual_hint: Manual order: drag the groups in the list (or use the arrows) to put them wherever you want within their level. Remembered on this device.
units.bulk_edit_hint: Check the fields you want to change and their new value: it's applied the same way to all selected units. Fields you don't check stay as they are on each one.
units.bulk_edit_mixed_types: The selected units are of different types: you can only change the cosmetic grade, functional grade or notes for all of them at once. To change other data (brand, model, RAM…) select units of the same type.
units.bulk_edit_notes_placeholder: Replaces the notes on all selected units
units.bulk_edit_sold_hint: If any of the selected units is already sold, nothing is changed: remove it from the selection and try again.

newUnit.lot_required: Choose the lot this unit belongs to.

assets.title: Company assets
assets.subtitle: Tools and equipment owned by the company. Not merchandise: no testing, locations or orders.
assets.new_hint: Uses the same equipment types and data you already have, but registered as company inventory, not for sale.
assets.empty_hint: Register the company’s tools and equipment with “New asset”.
assets.name: Name
assets.assigned_to_hint: Who has or looks after it
assets.quantity_hint: For several identical items (e.g. 5 screwdrivers): each gets its own code.
assets.quantity_serial: With a serial number only one asset is registered.
assets.type_change_hint: Changing the type clears the technical data, since it depends on the type.
assets.created_many: {{count}} assets registered ({{first}} to {{last}}). They are selected so you can print their labels.
assets.status_hint: E.g. “In repair” while not in use; “Retired” when it will no longer be used.
assets.delete_msg: Use it only if it was registered by mistake. If it is no longer used, set it to “Retired” instead to keep its history.
